pro_course_detail.description:
Unlock the language of law with our engaging Legal English course, specifically designed for lawyers, law students, and legal professionals at the intermediate level. This course is tailored to help you confidently communicate in English within the fields of American and British Common Law.

In this course you will build essential vocabulary and understanding of legal concepts. We cover areas such as contracts, criminal law, and intellectual property. Each lesson is carefully designed and structured to introduce you to legal terminology and communication whether you are preparing for work with international clients and colleagues or simply want to refine your Legal English. 

Course Focus:

Speaking and Conversation: Through real-world scenarios and lively discussions, you will develop fluency and confidence in discussing legal topics. We will focus on role-playing common legal interactions, client consultations, debates and mock court arguments to make learning interactive and practical.
  
- Grammar and Listening Practice: Learn the structures and forms most common in legal writing and speaking. We’ll work on mastering grammar to ensure clarity and precision, which are critical in legal language.
  
- Legal Writing Instruction and Practice: For those interested in refining their Legal English writing skills, we will offer guidance on drafting contracts, legal opinions, and formal emails. You’ll learn how to convey complex ideas with accuracy and professionalism.

Why This Course?

This course not only improves your Legal English but also sharpens your critical thinking and persuasive speaking. Together, we’ll explore contemporary cases and topics that bring excitement to each session. Join us to expand your English skills and deepen your knowledge of the legal world. Get ready for a challenging, fun, and rewarding learning experience! 

Let’s start speaking Legal English confidently—book your first lesson today!

pro_course_detail.title: Fun and Engaging Conversation Practice
pro_course_detail.description:
This class is designed for intermediate to advanced English learners who want to enhance their speaking skills and engage in meaningful conversations. Whether you're aiming to maintain your current level of English or seeking more opportunities to practice and apply what you already know, this class will help you put your foundational knowledge into action.

We’ll build on what you’ve learned, providing a supportive, judgment-free environment where you can speak as much as possible. We’ll focus on topics that matter to you—whether you prefer relaxed chats or more structured discussions. Instead of relying on textbook examples, we’ll tailor our conversations to your interests and preferences. We’ll work on fluency, pronunciation, and boosting your confidence, while also exploring idiomatic expressions and common phrases to make your speech sound more natural.

The key is to relax and enjoy the process. When you’re having fun, you’ll worry less about minor mistakes, and your language skills will improve effortlessly. Let’s make learning enjoyable and build your English-speaking abilities and confidence together!

pro_course_detail.title: Vocabulary and Comprehension (NEW!)
pro_course_detail.description:
If you’ve ever found yourself using the same words repeatedly or come across new words in conversations or texts that you’re unsure how to use, this class will help you expand your vocabulary and improve your understanding of English.

Here is what we will focus on in class :

Building Vocabulary in Context: You’ll learn new vocabulary that’s directly relevant to your life, work, and interests. No more random lists—each word or phrase will be connected to real situations, texts and topics making it easier to remember and use.

Real-Life Application: We’ll apply this vocabulary in real-life situations through conversations, discussions, and writing exercises, helping you feel confident and at ease when using it in both speaking and writing

Boosting Comprehension: We’ll tackle a variety of texts and audio sources, from news articles to videos and podcasts, helping you sharpen your skills in understanding spoken and written English.

Targeted Practice & Feedback: You’ll get fun, practical assignments to work on outside of class, and we’ll review your progress together. This ensures that you’re constantly improving both your vocabulary and comprehension.

This class is perfect if you’re looking to strengthen your vocabulary and deepen your comprehension of the English you encounter every day.

pro_course_detail.title: Grammar and Accuracy (NEW!)
pro_course_detail.description:
Unlike a regular conversation class where the focus is on speaking freely and building confidence, this class is designed to help you master the finer details of English grammar and ensure you’re speaking and writing with precision. We’ll concentrate on those tricky areas—verb tenses, prepositions, sentence structure, articles, conditionals, and more—to help you communicate not just fluently, but accurately.

Here’s what sets this class apart:

Personalized Error Correction: We’ll begin by identifying your most common grammar mistakes and work through them together using fun, practical exercises that are specific to your needs.

Grammar in Real-Life Situations: You won’t just learn rules in isolation. We’ll practice using correct grammar in meaningful, everyday contexts—whether it’s writing an email, telling a story, or speaking in a meeting.

Spotting Mistake Patterns: Together, we’ll uncover patterns in your errors and develop strategies to help you avoid them in the future.

Regular Practice & Feedback: You’ll have plenty of opportunities to practice your speaking and writing, with detailed, constructive feedback to guide your improvement.

If you want more than just conversation and are aiming for polished, confident communication, this class will give you the tools to not only be understood but to speak and write with accuracy and confidence. This class is ideal for students looking to take their English to the next level!

Please note- this class is an hour long class.
